title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How might post-training techniques like cascade RL redefine what's possible for large language models in the next decade?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Nemotron-Cascade 2 uses multi-domain on-policy distillation to boost reasoning and agentic capabilities, making LLMs more adaptable and efficient.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But with increased autonomy comes risk—what safeguards exist to prevent misuse or unintended consequences in real-world deployment?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are integrating alignment checks and domain-specific filters to ensure responsible use across varied applications.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: I see a future where AI agents collaborate with humans in healthcare, education, and research, enhancing decision-making with ethical oversight.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of AI lies in balancing innovation with accountability, guided by both technical progress and shared ethical values.
